Description / Source Summary: [SDG13] Climate Action: Limiting GHG emissions from agriculture, forestry, and land use. IPCC AR6 WG III (Chapter 7, 2022) estimates the likely economic AFOLU mitigation potential could be between ~8 to ~14 GtCO2eq/year between 2020 and 2050, where roughly 30-50% is realised at low cost. This target point represents a feasible benchmark for AFOLU mitigation under the deployment of low-cost measures.
